{{Quote|This massive fortress dominated by a deadly planetary defense gun has long been the symbol of Gamorrean strength and power.|[[Dax Gazaway]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Racer Revenge">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref>}}
The '''Citadel''' was a historical fortress on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. It contained a [[planetary defense gun]].

During the [[Rise of the Empire era]], the Citadel was the site of a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course. In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], [[Zanales]] was the track favorite.
